__comment: Editable food and drink listings. Add objects to items with id, name, category, cuisine, area, priceRange, halal, verifiedHalal, description, and mapsUrl.

items.name: Dishoom Covent Garden
items.description: A London favourite for black daal, grills, breakfast naan rolls, and theatre-district buzz. Ask staff for the latest halal meat details.

items.name: Padella
items.description: Queue-worthy handmade pasta beside Borough Market; the short menu is ideal for a quick, memorable lunch.

items.name: Flat Iron Soho
items.description: Simple, good-value steak, sides, and a lively Soho setting. Book or go early to avoid peak queues.

items.name: Kiln
items.description: Wood-fired Thai dishes, clay-pot noodles, and counter seats that make dinner feel close to the kitchen.

items.name: Brat
items.description: Smoky sharing plates and whole fish from a celebrated open-fire kitchen above Redchurch Street.

items.name: Manteca
items.description: House-made pasta, nose-to-tail cooking, and confident modern Italian plates near Old Street.

items.name: The Wolseley
items.description: A polished London classic for breakfast, afternoon tea, oysters, schnitzel, and old-school service.

items.name: Roti King
items.description: Fast, comforting Malaysian roti canai, nasi lemak, and curries. Always check current halal preparation with staff.

items.name: Chick 'n' Sours
items.description: Crispy chicken, punchy sides, and relaxed central dining close to theatres and Covent Garden.

items.name: Maedah Grill
items.description: Reliable halal grills, mezze, wraps, and family-friendly seating near East London Mosque.

items.name: Guanabana
items.description: Colourful halal-friendly plates, jerk flavours, burgers, mocktails, and a lively Camden setting.

items.name: The Great Chase
items.description: A polished halal dining room known for Sunday roasts, tasting menus, and alcohol-free pairings.

items.name: Etles Uyghur Restaurant
items.description: Hand-pulled noodles, lamb skewers, big-plate chicken, and warm service in north-east London.

items.name: Liman Restaurant
items.description: Fresh Turkish dishes, generous sharing plates, and a welcoming neighbourhood feel near the canal.

items.name: Monmouth Coffee
items.description: A London coffee institution with carefully sourced beans and a perfect stop before Borough Market.

items.name: Kaffeine
items.description: Excellent flat whites, pastries, and Australian-style cafe energy minutes from Oxford Street.

items.name: WatchHouse
items.description: Stylish London coffee with strong espresso, brunch plates, and several convenient branches.

items.name: Rosslyn Coffee
items.description: A serious coffee stop for City workers, with precise espresso and calm service.

items.name: Attendant
items.description: A distinctive cafe in a converted Victorian public convenience, known for brunch and coffee.

items.name: Borough Market
items.description: The essential food market for cheese, baked goods, oysters, paella, juices, and picnic supplies.

items.name: Maltby Street Market
items.description: Compact railway-arch market with creative street food, bakeries, and easy walks to Bermondsey Beer Mile.

items.name: Brick Lane Beigel Bake
items.description: A 24-hour East End institution for salt beef, smoked salmon, and no-frills late-night bites.

items.name: Camden Market Food Stalls
items.description: Huge choice of street food, desserts, and halal-friendly stalls. Ask individual vendors before ordering.

items.name: Gold Mine
items.description: A Bayswater favourite for roast duck, noodles, and comforting Cantonese classics.
